messages:
marta: Quick pulse — partner PMs want a single readiness matrix for H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi before the marketplace cutover next month. Can we triage gaps today?

ajay: On it. Do we need firmware + driver + marketplace SKU mapping in the same sheet?

danielle: Yes please. Also include which model variants we plan to GA (fp16/q4/q8) and any perf delta notes.

ryan: I'll add a column for 'fallback variant' if a SKU is delayed (eg H200 -> H100).

natalie: Heads up — Gaudi lab hit a thermal regression last week; we have a mitigation but it affects low-power SKUs. I'll flag affected SKUs.

marta: Good catch @natalie. Can you paste the short checklist for lab validation so partners know the gate?

natalie: Sure: ```- Driver >= 2.4.1 verified
- Microcode v0x1a applied
- Thermal soak test 2hr@80% load
- Perf regression <5% vs baseline```

ajay: For MI300 we need CUDA/ROCm matrix and the marketplace image tag. Suggest columns: vendor, hw_family, driver, image_tag, sku_tag, quant_profile, perf_notes, SI_cert 

danielle: Also add 'announce_blocker' boolean and 'press_embargo_window' date for cross-org comms.

ryan: I'll start a Google sheet and prefill known SKUs. Sharing in 10.

marta: Please include a short 'ask' column for partners (firmware drop, test farm access, docs). That helps track responsibles.

ops-bot: CI job marketplace-image-build/4132 completed: all image tags pushed to staging. :white_check_mark:

ajay: Nice. One more: are we gating any SKUs on SI-integration runs? Some SI partners need access to the same images for cert.

danielle: Yes — mark B200 variants as 'SI-cert required'. We'll coordinate dry-run next Tue.

natalie: I'll attach the failing thermal logs to the sheet as soon as Ryan shares it.

ryan: Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-ExampleLink - I put a 'README' tab with definitions. Filling the MI300 and Gaudi rows now.

marta: Great. Plan: finish matrix by EOD Friday, share to partner PMs, schedule a 30m sync next Mon to walk the gating items. @danielle @ajay can you join?

danielle: Yes.

ajay: Yep.

marta: Thanks team — this should let partners plan release windows and avoid last-minute embargo squeezes. :pray:
